newsitem.title: USA: NJ Transit awards $43 mln contract to Union Switch.
newsitem.headline: NJ Transit awards $43 mln contract to Union Switch.

text.p: NJ Transit's board of directors said Thursday it awarded a $43 million contract for a new rail safety system to Union Switch & Signal Inc of Pittsburgh.
The contract is for a demonstration project and the initial construction phases of Positive Train Stop, an automatic train braking system.
The first two phases of the project, which are scheduled to last 18 months, include testing and installation of the system on 108 miles of the transit system's lines.

The PTS system gives train engineers intermittent commands that can also take control of the train's movements if the engineer fails to respond. Advocates of the plan said the system could have prevented a fatal crash in 1996.
